case: custom enum[] CSV import preserves labels, native type and sibling rows
contract: Catalog metadata identifies a direct custom enum array's qualified element type.
CSV import builds a schema-qualified enum[] parameter cast and preserves literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, comma, quote, markup and SQL NULL labels.
Native pg_typeof, array_to_json and array_send checks verify the imported value; a pre-existing sibling row retains its wire bytes.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

focused_core_contracts.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core postgres_enum_array -- --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings
